Name: Herbs and Fungi
Author: Jared
Description: Adds 12 foraged mushroom varieties, 4 foraged berries (Blackcurrant, Redcurrant, Lingonberry, Cloudberry), 7 medicinal herbs (Chamomile, Dandelion, Yarrow, Ginseng, Wild Ginger, Plantain, Wild Flowers), hemp farming, mushroom log cultivation, and a drying/preservation system. Includes drying stacks and trays, oil press with seed/truffle/herbal oil recipes, pickling vat fermentation chain, 9 medicinal teas and Mushroom Broth (Chamomile, Dandelion, Ginseng, Reishi, Yarrow, Lion's Mane, Sleep, Stimulant, Anti-Nausea, Mushroom Broth), and 16 character-creation perks in the Situational tab (including Forest Scout, an opt-in trail-maintenance trait). Also adds 4 WorldMap locations (Foraging Path, Pine Clearing, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods) accessible from Primeval Woods.
